verdict.rationale: Relay documents categorizing expenses in real time and automatically syncing detailed transaction data to QuickBooks Online and Xero. That is its own capability for coding transactions to accounting categories. However, nothing shows the categorization is AI-driven or automatic rather than user-applied, and nothing shows it maps to GL codes across multiple entities. missing for 10: evidence of AI or automatic GL code assignment, multi-entity coding support, explicit close-acceleration workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
